t: This is Three Standing Figures, a large stone sculpture by Henry Moore, made in 1947 and 1948. It was shown here in Battersea Park in 1948, at the London County Council's first Open-Air Sculpture Exhibition. After it was donated to the council, it has stood in the park since 1950. It became a Grade II listed building in 1988. Moore is best known for his semi-abstract monumental sculptures, and he also drew Londoners sheltering from the Blitz.
